hero.title: Puzzles & books that take kids places.

about.title: Our Purpose
about.intro: Some families live under one roof. Others live under one sky.

mission.dedication: Dedicated to fathers left behind, and families reunited across borders
mission.title: Why we exist
body: For some fathers, the border falls right through the middle of the family: the money he doesn't have, the time he can't take, the duties that hold him in place while his kids grow up an ocean away. This is for the fathers still waiting, and the families who make it back. We can't undo the distance — only keep a hand held across it, one page at a time.

We were founded for those distances: for families separated by migration, and for the parents waiting on the far side of a border. Every book we publish is a small act of reunion — a story two people can share when they can't yet share a room. It goes where they can't: into an envelope, onto a screen, colored in two places at once.
Reuniting a family across borders is slow, and costly, and rarely fair. It is the cause we were built on, and the one we are still reaching toward — one page, one story, one homecoming at a time.

giving.title: Where it goes
giving.body: This was never only about books. As we grow, part of what we make goes toward the families furthest from reunion — the ones facing legal costs and closed doors with no way to pay for either. Every purchase is a small vote for a family getting to be together again.

cta.title: Join the adventure
cta.body: New books, puzzles, and the occasional bit of good news — sent only when there's something worth sharing.

about.benediction: Wherever you're reading this from, and whoever you're missing: the story isn't over. It's just being told across a longer distance for a while.
